mentions.name: BestOf journal reduction framework
mentions.description: An analog pen-and-paper framework that distills daily journals into a curated commonplace book: after writing a daily journal, the writer underlines the most resonant passages in red pen, waits a few days, copies only the best underlined sections into a separate 'BestOf' journal, and each week strikes through entries no longer needed, gradually producing a single repository of the best ideas from all daily journals.
mentions.problem: Reducing voluminous daily journals into high quality essential commonplace books
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on an analog framework to reduce journals into high quality essential commonplace books.

evidence.value: I’ve been working on an analog framework to reduce journals into high quality essential commonplace books.
